## 📓 Notes (optional)
_Screenshots, design decisions, or additional context._

The new url_reputation has the following checks.

- whitelist_domains: check a set of whitelisted domains
- allowed_patterns: regex patterns to be whitelisted
- blocked_domains: set of domains to block
- blocked_patterns: regex patterns to block 
- use_heuristic_check: true, heuristic checks of bad domains
- entropy_threshold: 3.65, Heuristic: Shannon entropy measure
- block_non_secure_http: true, Allow only https.
